title: Rolls of Harness Leather on Order
summary: Zeb Garrison says Greta Kemble has an order for 3 rolls of harness leather that cannot wait. The stock is at the spear hall yard, and the deadline is before the next muster.
offer_text: "Greta Kemble has an order and nobody to fetch it. Hear Greta out, then bring the goods from the spear hall yard before the next muster. I will vouch for you."

objectives.text: Take 3 rolls of harness leather from the spear hall yard
Hand the rolls of harness leather to Greta Kemble
